g.title: user_sessions
g.text: PARTIAL UNIQUE: user_id WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

g.title: notes
g.text: • exam_answers selected_option_id + question_id is a composite FK
• users.email is nullable at column level; staff email enforced by CHECK
• Partial unique indexes: one ACTIVE enrollment, one PENDING payment, one active cancellation request
• Several same-course / matching-type business rules need service or DB-level enforcement
